# Getting support

Thanks for using Locke. Here is where to go, depending on what you need — most
questions are answered fastest at the first two links.

## Using Locke or this extension

**[support.sonomos.ai](https://support.sonomos.ai)** is the help centre: how to
install the Locke desktop app, how the browser extension connects to it, what
the popup's status means, and troubleshooting for the common cases (extension
shows disconnected, a site behaves oddly, a request was blocked and you want to
know why).

The short version of how the pieces fit: **the extension does not work on its
own.** It holds an AI-bound request in your browser and asks the Locke desktop
app — running on the same machine — what to do with it. No desktop app, no
verdict, and the extension fails closed. The desktop app also installs and
registers the native messaging host the extension talks through, so there is
nothing to build or configure from this repository. A longer walkthrough lives
in [the wiki](https://github.com/sonomoshq/Locke-Extension/wiki).

## Security

- **Security posture, compliance and trust questions:**
  [trust.sonomos.ai](https://trust.sonomos.ai)
- **Reporting a vulnerability:** follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).
  Please do **not** open a public issue for anything security-sensitive.

## Bugs and questions about this repository

- **A bug in the extension:**
  [open an issue](https://github.com/sonomoshq/Locke-Extension/issues/new/choose).
  The template asks for the details that actually speed up a fix.
- **A question, or something that isn't clearly a bug:**
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/sonomoshq/Locke-Extension/discussions).

Bug and security reports are genuinely welcome. Note that we cannot accept pull
requests — the licence has no contribution path — but a good report is just as
useful. See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for why.

## Everything else

**[sonomos.ai](https://sonomos.ai)** for the company and product in general, or
`info@sonomos.ai` — including commercial licensing questions about this source.
